# Package replacement decisions for net10.0

Target: net10.0 (approved). Versions below are intended pins for `Directory.Packages.props`; the step that edits them should confirm the latest stable at edit time (`dotnet package search` / `dotnet list package --outdated`) and not cross a major without updating this doc. Current versions come from `Directory.Packages.props` at base commit e291473.

Project usage was taken from `*.csproj` references (structural, not evaluated MSBuild). Source-level API usage was not exhaustively assessed; each consuming step must run its own assessment.

| Current package (version) | Referenced by | Decision | Successor / version |
|---|---|---|---|
| EntityFramework 6.5.1 | DatabaseMigrationTools, NuGet.Services.CatalogValidation, NuGet.Services.DatabaseMigration, NuGet.Services.Validation, NuGetGallery, NuGetGallery.AppHost, NuGetGallery.Core | **Keep EF6 (compatible).** EF 6.5.x targets net6.0+/netstandard2.1 and runs on net10.0 using `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient`. Do not move to EF Core in this upgrade: the schema is shared and its migration history is EF6-owned. | `EntityFramework` 6.5.1 (unchanged) + `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` (latest stable 6.x); the EF6 `DbConfiguration` must register the SqlClient provider. EF Core 10 is a separate future work item. |
| Microsoft.Owin 4.2.2, .Security, .Security.Cookies, .Security.MicrosoftAccount, .Security.OpenIdConnect, Microsoft.Owin.Host.SystemWeb, Owin 1.0.0 | NuGet.Services.Owin, NuGetGallery.Services (NuGetGallery via Autofac.Owin) | **Replace** with ASP.NET Core middleware/authentication. `Host.SystemWeb` is System.Web-only and is dropped. NuGet.Services.Owin is rewritten as ASP.NET Core middleware or removed. | `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies`, `.MicrosoftAccount`, `.OpenIdConnect` (shared framework `Microsoft.AspNetCore.App` 10.0.x; no package pins). Remove Owin and Microsoft.Owin*. |
| WindowsAzure.Storage 9.3.3 | ArchivePackages, CopyAzureContainer, NuGet.Services.V3, SnapshotAzureBlob, SplitLargeFiles | **Replace** (deprecated; netstandard2.0/net472 only). The v12 SDKs are already pinned. | `Azure.Storage.Blobs` 12.22.2, `Azure.Storage.Queues` 12.18.0, `Azure.Data.Tables` 12.8.3 (all already pinned). Bulk copy (CopyAzureContainer): `Azure.Storage.DataMovement` + `Azure.Storage.DataMovement.Blobs` (latest stable) instead of `Microsoft.Azure.Storage.DataMovement` 0.9.0. Replace `Microsoft.WindowsAzure.ConfigurationManager` 3.2.3 (NuGetGallery.Core) with `Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration`. |
| System.ServiceModel (framework refs System.ServiceModel, .Activation, .Web) | NuGetGallery; tests/NuGetGallery.FunctionalTests uses `System.ServiceModel.Syndication` package | **Replace.** The framework assemblies do not exist on .NET. Syndication (RSS/Atom) is the likely use. | `System.ServiceModel.Syndication` (pinned 8.0.0; bump to 10.0.x). If WCF client use is found: `System.ServiceModel.Http` 8.x. `.Activation`/`.Web` have no successor; use ASP.NET Core routing. |
| NuGet.StrongName.elmah 1.2.2, NuGet.StrongName.elmah.sqlserver 1.2.2 | NuGetGallery | **Replace.** Classic ELMAH is System.Web-only (HttpModule/Handler). | `ElmahCore` + `ElmahCore.Sql` (latest stable 2.x), keeping `Infrastructure\Elmah.SqlServer.sql` schema (additive-only DB rule). Fallback if the error-log UI is not needed: Application Insights + ILogger. |
| NuGet.StrongName.WebActivator 1.4.4, WebActivatorEx 2.0.6 | NuGetGallery | **Remove.** Pre-start hooks move to `Program.cs` / `WebApplicationBuilder` and `IHostedService`. | none |
| Autofac.Mvc5 4.0.2, Autofac.Mvc5.Owin 4.0.1, Autofac.Owin 4.2.0, Autofac.WebApi2 4.1.0, Autofac 4.9.1 | NuGetGallery | **Replace integration packages; keep Autofac core**, upgraded. | `Autofac` 8.x + `Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection` 10.x (replaces 4.4.0) using `UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory())`; controllers via `AddControllersWithViews().AddControllersAsServices()`. Remove Mvc5, Mvc5.Owin, Owin, WebApi2. Autofac has one central version, so all consumers move to 8 together. |
| Microsoft.AspNet.Mvc 5.2.9, .Razor 3.2.9, .WebPages (+Data/WebData) 3.2.9, .WebHelpers 3.2.9, Microsoft.Web.Infrastructure | NuGetGallery, NuGetGallery.Services, NuGetCDNRedirect | **Replace** with ASP.NET Core MVC + Razor. Views need porting (`@helper`, `WebViewPage`, `HttpContext.Current`). | Shared framework only. |
| Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.* 5.2.9 (Core, WebHost, Client, Compression handler), WebApi.OData 5.7.0 | NuGetGallery | **Replace.** Controllers become MVC controllers; client -> `HttpClient`/`System.Net.Http.Json`; compression -> `AddResponseCompression`; OData v3 (V2 feed) -> `Microsoft.AspNetCore.OData` 9.x or hand-written endpoints (decide in web migration after assessing the surface). | see left |
| Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization 1.1.3, WebGrease 1.6.0 | NuGetGallery | **Replace** bundling/minification. | `LigerShark.WebOptimizer.Core` (latest stable) or npm/esbuild build-time bundling. |
| Microsoft.AspNet.Identity.Core 1.0.0, Microsoft.AspNet.DynamicData.EFProvider 6.0.0 | NuGetGallery / NuGetGallery.Services | **Replace/remove.** | Identity.Core: `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cryptography.KeyDerivation` (pinned 8.0.10; bump to 10.0.x) or `PasswordHasher`. DynamicData.EFProvider is System.Web-only: remove. |
| WindowsAzure.Caching 1.7.0, NuGet.StrongName.WebBackgrounder.EntityFramework 0.1.0 | NuGetGallery, NuGetGallery.Services | **Replace.** | Caching -> `Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.StackExchangeRedis` 10.0.x or `IMemoryCache`; WebBackgrounder -> `BackgroundService`. |
| Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http 2.2.2 | several | **Remove/upgrade.** Out of support. | Use `FrameworkReference Microsoft.AspNetCore.App` on net10.0. |

## Guidance for later steps

- Central pins change only through the foundation owner's process; add new packages to `Directory.Packages.props` in the step that first needs them, one version per package.
- Libraries (step 4) adopt `Azure.*` v12 and Autofac 8 first; web apps (step 6) own Owin/MVC/WebApi/Elmah/WebActivator removals.
- Open items for consuming steps: EF6 provider configuration with SqlClient, OData V2 surface, syndication usage in NuGetGallery, CopyAzureContainer data-movement semantics.
